{{Quote|We filed a flight plan with Rimsaw Station and Kura City Flight Control. And we had to fill out different forms for each one!|Myri Antilles to Unidentified E-wing pilot|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
